name: lookup_device
description: Look up an employee's laptop or phone: model, OS version, warranty end date and who it is assigned to.

name: reset_mfa
description: Remove the employee's registered two-factor devices so they can enroll a new phone. Use when they lost or replaced the phone that holds their codes.

name: request_software
description: Ask for a software license or install for an employee. Goes to their manager for approval.

name: check_vpn_status
description: Show whether the company VPN gateways are up and whether the employee's last VPN sign-in failed.

name: open_incident
description: Open an IT incident for something that is broken for many people (an outage), not for one person's problem.

name: book_device_swap
description: Book a slot at the IT desk to swap a broken laptop or phone for a loaner.
